Song: ‘Under the Winter, dear’

Eugene Lee-Hamilton (1845–1907)

U
NDER
 the Winter, dear,
Summer’s note lieth:
If it be sweet to hear,
Song never dieth.
Soon in the forest, love,
Breezes shall bear it;
There, in the bough above,
Lo, thou shalt hear it.
